picks.title: It’s Time to Come Home — Saturated Thursday: Jennie Allen
picks.summary:
Revival begins with repentance.
In Luke 15, Jesus tells the story of two sons who are both far from the heart of their father. One runs to a distant country while the other stays home but is blinded by his own pride. Yet the invitation for both is the same: come home.
In this message, Jennie Allen challenges us to throw off the sin and weight holding us back, bring what has been hidden into the light and believe the truth of the gospel: there is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. Whether you have wandered far or simply forgotten how desperately you need God, the Father is ready
picks.reason: A call to repentance and spiritual renewal grounded in a biblical parable.

picks.title: EP: 468 The Church is Afraid of the Supernatural with Jon Moffitt
picks.summary:
Jon Moffitt is a Reformed pastor, and in his world, you do not talk about this. Demons, principalities, the divine council, the unseen war Paul describes in Ephesians. It is not that the Reformed church calls it heresy. It is that the Reformed church is so afraid of looking charismatic that it simply goes quiet. Jon lives in that silence for years, until he sits down to preach the Lord's Prayer and gets stuck on one line. Deliver us from the evil one. He realizes he has never heard a single sermon on it, and pulling that thread unravels everything he thought he was allowed to say.

picks.reason: A pastor confronts spiritual warfare and unseen realities within a Christian framework.
